sloka: एवमुक्तस्तया तत्र वेदवत्या निशाचरः ।मूर्धजेषु तदा कन्यां कराग्रेण परामृशत् ।। ७.१७.२७ ॥
transliteration: evamuktastayā tatra vedavatyā niśācaraḥ ।mūrdhajeṣu tadā kanyāṁ karāgreṇa parāmṛśat ।। 7.17.27 ॥

translations.english: Vedavati, the maiden, told the night-wanderer Ravana, "No, not so!" and asked, "O king of Rakshasas, who else among intelligent beings, besides you, would disrespect Vishnu, the lord of the three worlds, who is worshipped by all?"
